cases.name: failures
cases.fairness: Temporal liveness obligations explicitly imply the original per-action Fairness predicate. Step includes stuttering; nextStep preserves the original enabled relation.

assumptions: Checked formula in ApprovalService_failures: SettlesOnce = always(( Set("selected", "timedOut", "cancelled", "rejected").forall(result => s.result == result implies next(s.result) == result) ).orKeep(s))
No scheduler fairness is assumed by this property.
Checked formula in ApprovalService_failures: CallerSettles = Fairness implies eventually(s.result != "none")

Model fairness predicate Fairness = and { Fire.weakFair(s), TGetTask.weakFair(s), any { TCallbackDone, TCallbackFails }.weakFair(s), TResolve.weakFair(s), TDelete.weakFair(s), Selectors.forall(i => and { SGetTask(i).weakFair(s), any { SCallbackDone(i), SCallbackFails(i) }.weakFair(s), SDelete(i).weakFair(s) }) }
The stated fairness is an assumption about enabled model actions; runtime scheduling and provider completion are not proved.
Checked formula in ApprovalService_failures: DeadlockFree = always(enabled(nextStep))
No scheduler fairness is assumed by this property.
